name: Atavistic Magic
body:
You have gained access to some psychic magic secrets.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, atavistic caster class feature.

Benefit(s): Choose a 1st-level spell, a 2nd-level spell, a 3rd-level spell, and a 4th-level spell from the spiritualist spell list. Add those spells to your list of bloodrager spells known.

Once chosen, these spells cannot be changed.
